## Description

Employs continuous normalizing flows and score-based flow matching to generate high-fidelity artificial order book message streams and limit order book depth scenarios for backtesting.

## Where it may fit

Stress testing HFT execution strategies, training reinforcement learning agents under data scarcity.

## Vehicles

High-frequency trading firms, quantitative risk management groups.

## Required data

High-frequency historical limit order book message logs and execution event timestamps.

## Caveats

Flow matching ordinary differential equation numerical integration requires efficient ODE solvers.
